ssa_oasdi.source: SSA Social Security Administrative Expenses, calendar-year 2024 row
ssa_oasdi.verified: 2026-10-15, official primary page opened through web tool
ssa_oasdi.basis: CY2024, administrative expenses, millions of dollars
ssa_oasdi.limit: Trust-fund administrative cash expenses are not the NIPA consumption-by-function mass. OASI alone exceeds the entire BEA federal retirement C+GI block, so a direct substitution fails the bridge.

ssa_ssi.source: 2025 SSI Annual Report, Single-Year Table IV.E1, 2024 row
ssa_ssi.verified: 2026-10-15, official primary page opened through web tool
ssa_ssi.basis: FY2024, administrative expenses, millions of dollars
ssa_ssi.limit: Includes state-supplement user fees. Fiscal-year expenses and beneficiary services do not establish calendar-year net NIPA consumption.

medicaid.source: CMS Financial Management Report FY2024, FY 2024 FMR NET EXPENDITURES.xlsx, ADM - National Totals, row 64 Total Net Expenditures
medicaid.limit: Federal/state columns are financing shares of the same state program administration. Do not add both to total. FY/CY timing, territories, capital, fees and NIPA function boundary not bridged; never insert the national amount into both government levels.

snap.source: USDA FNS SNAP State Activity Reports official page
snap.verified: 2026-10-15 official page discovery and indexed text; fns.usda.gov direct open returned 403
snap.limit: Located official report page describes FY2023 data as of December2024. Do not relabel FY2023 as FY2024 or infer a 2024 program mass from the generally 50 percent federal reimbursement rule. SNAP caseload proxy is measured from CPS separately.

census_welfare.source: 2024 State Government Finances technical documentation, pages 4-5
census_welfare.verified: 2026-10-15 official primary PDF opened through web tool
census_welfare.limit: From survey 2022 E74/E75 vendor payments and J/M67/68 cash assistance consolidated into E79/M79/S89. E79 is not a program-pure administrative mass.

bea_methodology.sections: IV pages 3-7; NIPA conversion uses netting, coverage, timing, consumption of fixed capital
bea_methodology.limit: Source budget administration outlays cannot replace a NIPA consumption block without conversion.
